articleTitle: Overview of Machine Learning Technologies in Medicine
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: Machine learning technologies are being actively implemented in the healthcare sector to provide monitoring, diagnostics and decision support processes. This article discusses software products, the scope of which is medicine, and the development of which uses machine learning and artificial intelligence technologies. Semantic chatbots and health monitoring systems on the market were analyzed.

articleTitle: Deploying MANET on a Raspberry Pi 4 Model B Test Bench Using the B.A.T.M.A.N. Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: Mobile Ad Hoc Network (MANET) is a non-centralized, self-regulating, easy-to-deploy wireless ad hoc network that can be found in specific applications such as military scenarios, sensor networks, vehicle-to-vehicle communication. Better Approach to Mobile Ad hoc Networking (B.A.T.M.A.N.), developed by the Freifunk community, was chosen as the routing protocol in MANET. The Raspberry Pi series single board computers provide a compact, mobile and low-cost platform that satisfies the required hardware base for MANET deployment. In this paper, three minicomputers Raspberry Pi 4B computers with 4 gigabytes of RAM are used as in MANET as mobile nodes. The testbed presents a lot of experimentation, arranging communication between mobile nodes, analyzing the functionality of the routing protocol and managing communication messages on each node, which can help with many problems present in real-life scenarios for operating MANET systems. The main task is to evaluate performance of such a network is evaluated in two use scenarios using three important metrics: message latency, average channel throughput, and packet delivery ratio.

articleTitle: Dynamic Behavior of Gas Bubbles and Droplets in Magnetic Fluids in Microfluidic Chips of Various Configuration in Inhomogeneous Magnetic Field
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: Droplet formation in microchannels has a large number of applications such as microdosers and gas meters. The paper investigates the effect of the wettability of the walls of a microfluidic chip on the for generation of microdrops in the channel. It is shown that the flow speed and value of magnetic field strength have an effect on the size of droplets and bubbles formed in a ferrofluid in a microfluidic chip.

articleTitle: Dynamics of Levitated Volume of the Composite Bidisperse Magnetic System
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: Magnetic fluids have become popular due to a special combination of properties and the ability to change their physical parameters, such as viscosity, sound speed, light transmission with a change in the external magnetic field. Under specific conditions, interaction between magnetic nanoparticles, the forming and decay of aggregation, and a variation in their physic characteristics take place to composite bidisperse magnetic system. We have developed an original method for measuring the viscoelastic parameters of magnetic fluid systems, and test it on different magnetic composite fluids include bidisperse systems. Examples with various physic properties are studied and the viscosity dependence on the magnetic fied is investigated. The structure of the bidisperse examples with magnetic particles affect the dynamics of sample subjected to oscillatory shifts and magnetoviscous effects.

articleTitle: Deep Transfer Learning for Sleep Stages Classification by EEG Data
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: Sleep is one of the key factors of well-being affecting life quality and longevity, which makes sleep monitoring an important task. In this paper, we propose the transfer learning approach for sleep stages classification based on EEG recordings, aiming the analysis of the patient's sleep quality. Transfer learning makes training possible with a small amount of labeled data. Also, usually it takes less time to fine-tune a pretrained model. For the numerical experiments, we use an open PhysioNet Sleep-EDF dataset containing more than 150 EEG files with annotations, and recurrent autoencoder network TimeNet. The proposed approach provides the highest achievable binary classification accuracy when only 10% of labeled data used for training.

articleTitle: Development of a Mathematical Model for a Moving Platform for the Diagnosis of the Spinal State
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: Quantitative functional estimation of Posture and Motion Analysis of the spine has been highly demanded recently. Furthermore, the high frequency of observation of cases of posture disorders and spinal deformities, the need for early detection of functional manifestations of these pathological conditions, and control of their dynamics during treatment necessitate the development of methods for assessing violations of the kinematics of the spine during walking. This paper suggests a mathematical and mechanical model for a moving platform for assessing spine distortion during walking.

articleTitle: Technologies for Reducing and Controlling Greenhouse Gas Emissions into Atmosphere
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: The problem of emissions of greenhouse gases into the atmosphere has been studied. Various solutions are considered using a number of technologies to reduce greenhouse gas emissions into the atmosphere. One of them is related to the transition to alternative forms of energy. Now the energy industry uses a large percentage of gases with a high global warming potential. Most of these gases are freons. To reduce the negative impact of these greenhouse gases on climate change, it is necessary to switch to technologies that use environmentally friendly analogues of these gases or eliminate them altogether. To control greenhouse gas emissions, it is proposed to use the GLONASS satellite constellation. The technique of control of greenhouse gases with the use of satellite systems is considered. The obtained results are presented.

articleTitle: Problems of Extrapolation of Rat Cardiac Signal Data to Humans
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: Modern medicine requires conducting biomedical experiments on animals, but there is always a question about the correctness of the extrapolated data obtained during the experiment on the human body. So, for example, when modeling pathologies of cardiac disorders in rats, techniques can be used, including with the removal of parts of organs or the replacement of food to achieve the early development of a condition similar to the pathological condition of a person. Based on this, the urgent task is to consider the existing methods of data extrapolation and highlighting their main problems in order to form possible solutions and improve the data obtained.

articleTitle: Development of a Device for Prediction the ph of the Environment Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: The research task was to develop a device for monitoring and predicting the state of the environment. The parameter pH was taken as a basis, which was used as the main criterion for assessing the state of the environment. The paper shows the implementation of this idea on the PYNQ-Z2 board using machine learning algorithms. The results are presented as TP FP matrices. This work makes it possible to predict environmental problems and the well-being of the environment, which can subsequently be used to improve the quality of life.

articleTitle: Improving the Reliability of Results in Pulse Wave Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: The need for further research on transmission pulse oximetry for various applications (clinical medicine or personal use) has been justified. We construct a database from groups of people with different health statuses and identify several factors that negatively affect the parameters of recorded pulse waves (signal-to-noise ratio, wavefront structure). Mathematical functions have been developed to obtain additional information during pulse wave processing to improve the reliability of the results. A new technique is proposed based on the pulse rate, waveform, and oxygen saturation information. It helps to get more reliable information about the presence of deviations in the state of human health during the process of express diagnostics.

articleTitle: Assement of the Air Environment in St. Petersburg and Its Nearest Suburbs
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: The necessity of a comprehensive assessment of the state of the environment in real time in various areas of the city of Saint-Petersburg and its suburbs is substantiated. A technique for assessing the state of the environment in real time is proposed. The results to the assessing of air environment state in Saint-Petersburg and the nearest suburbs obtained using an automated monitoring system are presented. An analysis of data obtained was carried out and a comparison was made with the results in 2020 and 2021 years. The list to the largest sources of pollution has been established and compiled, ranked by gross emissions. The possible directions of human activity to reduce the level of air pollution are indicated.

articleTitle: Development of Migration-Dosimetric Model for the Formation of Irradiation of Herbaceous Plants with Constant Radioactive Emissions
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: In this article the existing methods for evaluating the radioactive emissions influence on the environment, are reviewed. The migration-dosimetric model for the formation of irradiation of herbaceous plants is presented. The stages of influence evaluation included in this model are determined. The calculations of this model according to the data on standard emissions from the Leningrad nuclear power plant were carried out. The calculation results are presented.

articleTitle: Study of Impedance Frequency Dependences of Healthy and Depulpated Teeth
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: The most common dentistry methods for depulped teeth identification is electrodontometry and radiography, which cause the patient to feel uncomfortable. One of the promising methods for determining depulpated teeth is a method based on measuring the tooth tissues impedance. The paper presents the results of in vitro studies of teeth impedance frequency dependence before and after their depulpation. Depulpation was performed according to the standard procedure using gutta-percha pins and a sealer. Experimental studies were carried out in the laboratory of the St. Petersburg State Electrotechnical University “LETI” using the immitance meter E7-20 and specially designed measuring sensors. The experimental results obtained on 20 samples in vitro showed that the impedance values of depulpated teeth are more than 30% higher than its values for healthy teeth in frequency range from 25 Hz up to 100 kHz. These results were confirmed by studies on a small sample in vivo.

articleTitle: Development of a Miniature Integrated Heavy Metal Sensor Based on Composite Electrode Materials and Printed Electronics Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: This paper reports an innovative, low cost, and efficient heavy metal sensor with an ink jet printed carbon composite electrode for advanced electrochemical sensing. The electrochemical sensor consists of three electrodes, including composite carbon as a working and counter electrode and silver paste/silver chloride as a reference electrode. The sensor was tested using anode stripping voltammetry measurements of model solutions. The detection limit achieved was 10 ·10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−9</sup> mol/L.

articleTitle: Medical System for Monitoring the Health Status of the Rural Population
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: Currently, the negative dynamics of rural population health status is observed. The reasons and primary diseases of the rural population that lead to death are determined. Using data mining methods, we propose effective methods for monitoring health status in an express mode which are non-invasive, affordable, and safe. An 18-channel electronic sensor unit of the system is developed, which includes optical sensors and a module for wireless information transmission. The developed optical system for express monitoring of the oxygen status of tissues can be used both for automated assessment of the functional state of a person and for monitoring his recovery after therapy.

articleTitle: Wearable Long-Term Cardiac Monitoring System Based n Capacitive Sensors Connected by Stretchable Interconnections
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: Holter ECG systems are used to detect cardiovascular diseases. They extend the diagnostic capabilities of stationary electrocardiographs and can monitor heart function over time. A wearable long-term cardiac monitoring system has been developed that records standard 12-lead electrocardiogram. Measurement of electric potentials from the skin surface is performed by a group of capacitive sensors connected by stretchable cables to the processing device. It is possible to transmit ECG data to the doctor using a USB cable, MicroSD Card or Bluetooth and a smartphone. The integrated MEMS sensor records and transmits patient position and motion data for comparison with the electrocardiogram. A description of the design and operation of the functional units of the system are presented.

articleTitle: Development of Microfluidic Biochip for Express Determination of Doxorubicin in Blood
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: The topology, manufacturing technology and design of a microfluidic biochip and a detection system for the quantitative determination of the antitumor drug doxorubicin in blood have been studied. The topology of the microfluidic system was developed on the basis of previous experience and considering the necessity of sample volume reduction as well as isolation of blood cells. The detection volume for fluorimetric measurement of doxorubicin was provided with the integrated lens in order to increase the fluorescence detection aperture. The doxorubicin registration was carried out at excitation wavelength of 470 nm, by using CMOP sensor.

articleTitle: Current Challenges of Magnetic Nanoparticle-Based Hyperthermia
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: The work is devoted to a review of existing methods of hypothermia using nanoparticles, as well as an analysis of the shortcomings and factors hindering the development of the application of this method. The scope of the method and its varieties are described. The main factors influencing on the creation of a mathematical model of electromagnetic processes describing parameters of the electromagnetic field distribution in a biological object are identified. The main shortcomings of the modern representation of the physics processes of the hypothermia are described. Issues related to the delivery and localization of nanoparticles in the required area of impact are considered. An analysis of the methods of heating the particles and calculating the specific power of the impact is given. Algorithm for the gradual overcoming of the factors hindering the development and application of the method is proposed.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Possibility of Using Machine Learning to Solve Problems of Object Classification with a Lack of a Priori Information on the Example of Observing Living Organisms
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: The solution is considered by learning on examples of object classification problems described by a set of data with a large number of degrees of freedom - color images, multidimensional processes with a wide spectrum, etc. The minimum sizes of the training set necessary for the classification of such objects are estimated depending on the available a priori information about the properties of the classes being separated.

Author Keywords: amount of information in a sample

articleTitle: A Filtering Algorithm to Improve the Visibility of the Mandibular Canal Projection on the CT Scan Images of the Jaw
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: In this paper, filters used for medical images processing are considered. The results of applying each filter to a two-dimensional image (section of the CT scan of the jaw in the frontal plane), as well as the effect of each filter on the visibility of the mandibular canal on the image are shown. Several filters were chosen, and the sequence of their application was determined. It allows improving the visibility of the mandibular canal in computed tomography images. A criterion that allows to compare the results of applying of the sequence of filters and choose the best one was created. This processing algorithm allows to prepare images before applying it to the input of the recognition model and improve the quality of the model.

articleTitle: The Reliability of the Method for Detecting Scattered Laser Radiation in the Case of Determining Atmospheric Air Pollution by Dust Particles
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: Measuring the size and concentration of fine particulate matter in the air is of high importance for big cities with a population of more than 1 million people. Optical devices are used with the functions of determining the parameters and distribution of particles by size. The principle of operation of such devices is diffuse laser radiation. The article provides an analysis of the method for finding the above mentioned parameters based on the concept of Mie diffraction and the assumption that fine particles are of spherical shape. The scattering curves of laser radiation indicatrices on dust particles 2.5 and 10 µm in size were calculated, and the particle size allocation function was estimated under the condition of determining the intensity of diffuse light at more than 2 angles at which scattering occurs. The possibility of misinterpretation of the results of measurements by widely used portable measuring devices for the parameters of dust particles is shown.

articleTitle: Microfluidic System for Dielectrophoretic Separation of Microbiological Objects
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: Microfluidic systems allows to precisely manipulate small volumes of samples, which is very important in the manufacture and processing of nanomedical preparations, for example, based on magnetic nanoparticles. The development of such systems will allow the creation of new drugs with high productivity. Dielectrophoresis is an affordable and technologically advanced technique for separating and manipulating objects in a chip channel. The paper considers various topologies of electrodes integrated into a microfluidic system based on ORDYL FP 440 film photoresist, and investigates their functional characteristics and modes. On the example of model objects (yeast cells), the operability of the resulting system with a low cost of manufacturing and prototyping for separating samples in a microvolume is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Non-Invasive Sensory System for the Analysis of the Acid-Base State of Biological Tissues
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: Hydrogen ions play a special role in the biochemical processes of plastic and energy metabolism in the human body. We have developed a sensor system that allows quickly and with a sufficiently high reproducibility control pH level of human skin. It is based on the use of potentiometric electrodes: a pH-sensitive elec-trode and a reference electrode. The results of measurements of 10 volunteers showed that pH of women wrist tissues is on average 0.34 pH units higher than that of men. There was also a tendency to increase pH of skin areas on flexor surfaces of forearms and back of the hand with increasing age. Thus, the developed measurement technique may indicate a number of problems associated with the acid-base state of biological tissue sites, depending on the endogenous effects.

articleTitle: Portable Device for Monitoring the Health of Pregnant Women
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: The paper discusses the development of a portable device for monitoring the condition of a pregnant woman, the relevance of the topic, selection of the main indicators on which the patient's health status is assessed. Also, methods for registration of these parameters are described. As a result of the work performed, a device for monitoring the condition of a pregnant woman was proposed, its performance was evaluated and advantages are highlighted in comparison with the existing analogues, and possible ways to improve the accuracy of removal and evaluation of indicators are presented.

articleTitle: Model of Short- Term Regulation of Arterial Blood Pressure Based on Experimental Data
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: The purpose of the research was to develop a model of short-term regulation of blood pressure, designed to solve the problem of indirect assessment of arterial blood pressure. Based on the literature data and scientific articles related to the research topic, a set of biomedical signals and parameters characterizing the interaction of the main contours of baroreceptor regulation of blood pressure was formed in the work, ways to improve existing models were proposed. As a result, a prototype model of baroreceptor regulation of blood pressure was implemented. To carry out experimental testing, a method of biomedical research was developed to obtain the necessary signals and data, as well as a method for generating input loads based on the formed database of biomedical signals and parameters.

articleTitle: Increasing the Separation Efficiency of Electro-Acoustic Device by Coupling with Multichannel Microfluidic System
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: In this work, we study the increase in particle separation efficiency by using a multichannel microfluidic system integrated with an electroacoustic actuator. Electroacoustic modules based on interdigital transducers with different configurations have been studied. A mathematical model is presented for calculating acoustic fields in a microfluidic system based on the parameters of interdigital transducers. Based on the simulation results, an optimized multichannel microfluidic system was designed. Separation efficiency was analyzed using a heterogeneous particle suspension. The observed increase in the separation efficiency enabled a total performance of the system to be increased.

articleTitle: An Improved Clustering Algorithm for Segmentation of MRI Brain Images Using Small-World Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: The process of image segmentation is widely used in dividing medical images into various clusters. A magnetic Resonance Image (MRI) is an essential auxiliary instrument to diagnose abnormalities. However, the drawback of the MRI image is the presence of noise. Reducing the noise is vital to achieving a suitable quality in segmentation. This paper presents an improved fuzzy clustering in which a small-world network architecture tries to increase the quality of the MRI images especially those related to the brain. The small-world network increases the clustering accuracy because of shortcuts between the cluster, which causes finding a suitable cluster. Experimenting on a real data set shows an improvement in image segmentation quality while increasing the time consumption is negligible.

articleTitle: Assessment of the Ecological State of Water Bodies of the Leningrad Region of Russian Federation in Agricultural Zones of Various Types Using an Integral Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: The article discusses the stages of constructing an integral indicator of the natural state of water ecosystems, and also builds a classification model for evaluating the condition of water ecosystems. An evaluation of the natural state of the water ecosystems of the Leningrad region was carried out. The result of an integral evaluation of the natural state of lakes using three priority properties (acute toxicity determined by the change in the percentage of dead daphnia in the test sample, acute toxicity determined by variations of the optical density of the tested object the optical density of the test object Chlorella vulgaris, toxicity index for Paramecium caudatum) showed that the state only one of the water body is. It is the Gruzinka River safe in the Leningrad Region. The rest of the water bodies are characterized by a satisfactory ecological state.

articleTitle: Detection of Dangerous Arrhythmias Using a 1D Convolutional Neural Network Trained on the Full Spectrum of a Short ECG Signal
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: An essential practical task is the timely recognition of dangerous arrhythmias since the early detection of this pathology can prevent mortality and improve the quality of life. The article considers a solution to the problem of heart rhythm disturbances binary classification using the 1-Dimensional Convolutional Neural Network. The work focused on the detection of dangerous ventricular arrhythmias because of their severe consequences. We used the full spectrum of two-second fragments of the electrocardiogram for model training. 1D CNN architecture for sequence classification allows learning directly on raw data while showing satisfactory results. The model achieved an overall test accuracy of 95.7 percent with sensitivity and specificity of 97.7% and 90.2%, respectively.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence in Determining the Pregnancy Pathologies
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: During pregnancy, timely diagnosis of the health of the mother and fetus is important. The most common method for diagnosing the condition of the fetus is ultrasound, but the planned nature of this procedure does not allow for the rapid detection of pregnancy pathologies. For this reason, it became necessary to develop diagnostic methods that would be based on signals from round-the-clock monitoring, a subjective assessment of the woman's condition, and taking into account risk factors. This article proposes the concept of a system for determining both pregnancy pathologies and their predictors using artificial intelligence technologies.

Author Keywords: monitoring the health of a pregnant woman

articleTitle: Effective Analog Filtration of Bioelectric Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: This paper considers ways of increasing efficiency of band-stop filtration: the possibility of adjusting quality factor and band-stop frequency, the use of band-stop filters pair with a slight difference in frequency. Scheme which implements the mentioned methods has been developed by authors. This circuit has been simulated in the Micro-Cap12 structural and circuitry modeling program using different test and real ECG signals, including signals simulating network interference. The importance of the mentioned ways of increasing the effectiveness of band-stop filtering is shown. Recommendations on creation of band-stop filters for processing bioelectrical signals are given.

articleTitle: Portable System for Respiratory Monitoring During Sleep
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: Polysomnography is the most reliable but, at the same time, the most complex and expensive method for diagnosing sleep apnea. The patient overpays for a procedure that is unnecessary for making a diagnosis. Therefore, a portable system for respiratory monitoring during sleep is crucial to evaluate the sleep status of individuals. This article presented a portable system for monitoring respiratory signals during sleep. In contrast to traditional sleep laboratory techniques, the proposed approach can be utilized at the house and in hospitals to clarify breathing patterns during sleep that will observe the patient's sleep status. A prototype of a portable system for respiratory monitoring during sleep is designed. The prototype consists of three central units. First, a measurement unit is connected to the patients, where the airflow signal is detected using a pressure sensor. The efficiency of the pressure sensor was tested using an Arduino board to ensure that the measurement would be more accurate than a temperature sensor. The second unit is data acquisition and digitization. in this unit, the noise filtration, amplification, and conversion of the analog signal to digital signal occur. Finally, the third unit is where the signal processing and data analysis are done. Again, a friendly user interface is developed using MATLAB App Designer to process the signal and analyze the breathing parameters of the input signal.

articleTitle: New Small-Sized Mass Spectrometer for Water Alkane Density Determination
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: The necessity of monitoring the state of water at sea depths is substantiated. A technique for monitoring alkanes in water at various depths is proposed to identify changes that can have a significant impact on the marine life. The design of a portable mass spectrometer has been developed for determining the concentration of alkanes in water, taking into account the composition of the gas mixture released during the delivery of water to the device, from depths of up to 30 m, in real time. The device's lower power consumption and significantly lower relative error rates set it apart from other similar devices. The measurement results are presented.

articleTitle: Biointerfaces: Types, Application and Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: In recent years, biofeedback technology has become one of the perspective areas in biomedical engineering. The successful introduction of biointerfaces into various spheres of everyday life is associated with several advantages to their use and unique capabilities they are providing. These include lost body functions replacement, a possibility to remotely control different electronic devices and implementation of the natural control. Due to the variety of control signals, corresponding subtypes of these devices have been created. The purpose of this work is to describe the most used biointerfaces types and to consider the application areas of this technology. Existing research papers and designs were analyzed and compared. An overview of commercially successful projects is presented. This work can be useful for general familiarization with the topic, or in case of choosing the biointerface type for device development.

articleTitle: Features of Integral Assessment for Water Objects in Agricultural Activity Areas
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: In the presented paper, an increase in anthropogenic load on water bodies in areas of active agriculture, especially near large megacities was noted. Also, the necessity of permanent monitoring of water bodies has been substantiated. Integral methodology for increasing the efficiency of monitoring of water bodies is proposed and three criteria for the implementation of this methodology have been selected. The research of the state part of the lake “Vuoksa” with the use of the developed methodology was conducted. Finally, paper defines tasks that should be solved to increase the efficiency of the proposed integral assessment of the condition of the water body.

articleTitle: Analytical Comparison Between Biomechanics Parameters for Normal and Crouch Gait
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: Crouch gait is one of the familiar pathological gait patterns, usually induced by cerebral palsy. Determined by extreme knee flexion during the stance phase is a considerable issue that concerns the inhabitants of children with spastic cerebral palsy. Gait analysis proposes various biomechanical parameters through which to quantify gait. This article introduces an analytical comparison between biomechanics parameters for normal and Crouch gait. Various biomedical parameters were assessed, such as knee flexion angle, ankle angle, hip flexion angles, lumbar bending, hamstring length, and knee angle moment arm for other crouch and normal gaits.

articleTitle: Development of Portable Spectrophotometer for Remote Health Monitoring of Patients with Chronic Diseases
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: The article describes the principles of developing a low-cost portable visible-range spectrophotometer for the analysis of biological fluids, suitable for medical use and providing fast and reliable measurements in the conditions of remote diagnosis of the patient. The list of probable measured parameters with brief characteristics of measurement methods is given. Their features are investigated and the structure of the measuring system of the device is determined. The possibility of comparing the data measured by the device with the reference values of the parameters is analyzed.

articleTitle: Study of Protein a Binding to Omalizumab and Their Application for Quality Control of Biosensor Substrates Silanization
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: The development of new biosensor systems is essential for express diagnostics of diseases. To create them, it is necessary to investigate and optimize the sequence of technological processes. Such systems can be implemented using biorecognition elements immobilized in the active region of the sensor. One of the key stages of this technology is the treatment of a glass substrate in order to form silanol groups on its surface for attaching analyte-selective ligands to it. This paper discusses the use of the “Protein A - Omalizumab” pair to control the quality of the silanization process. This complex was tested by capillary electrophoresis and demonstrated its binding on the treated substrate. Recommendations are given for modifying peptide aptamers in order to their effective immobilization.

articleTitle: Implementation and Methods of a Medical Expert System for Diagnosing Epilepsy in Children
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: This paper proposes an algorithm for constructing expert systems (ES) in comparison with a physician's decision to determine epilepsy in children. A decision tree method (DTM), which provides a therapeutic and diagnostic process, is proposed. A method of medical data analysis is proposed, which makes it possible to determine the type of epilepsy in children.

articleTitle: Calculation of Pollutants Mass Emissions Producing by Traffic Flows
publicationTitle: 2023 Seminar on Digital Medical and Environmental Systems and Tools (DMEST)
abstract: Methods for taking into account the urban road network characteristics influencing air pollution emission levels are studied. Existing road classification approaches are considered, significant characteristics affecting pollutant emissions are identified, including the roads design features, traffic characteristics and features of the urban environment. An algorithm and a software module for calculating pollutant mass emissions produced by traffic flows have been developed.
